note: Robot abilities (design brief §13-16). All robots are toys at Retrobot's scale (~30 cm). Assembly parts are each robot's items in robot_parts.json; a robot activates when every part is installed at its repair-bay station. Distances/heights in metres, speeds in m/s, times in seconds. Player: walk 3.0 m/s, eye height 1.62 m. reach_height: highest a part may lie for the robot to pick it up, and highest destination it can store into; lower robots pile parts in front of destinations above their reach (still unsorted) for Hoverbot. max_item_size: largest part (longest side) it can lift. heap_step_height: parts lying higher than this are obstacles (it walks around heaps).

retrobot.name: Retrobot
retrobot.personality: Earnest, enthusiastic, slightly clumsy. One part at a time, always knows where it belongs.

unibot.name: Unibot
unibot.personality: Energetic, slightly nervous, constantly balancing. A fast courier.

spiderbot.name: Spiderbot
spiderbot.personality: Curious, methodical, precise. Clambers over heaps and under furniture.

caterpillarbot.name: Caterpillarbot
caterpillarbot.personality: Slow, determined, dependable. Hauls big loads in three cargo boxes.

hoverbot.name: Hoverbot
hoverbot.personality: Curious, enthusiastic, slightly overactive. Reaches the high shelves and stores the piles the small robots leave.
